design: Hybrid NOSS E-value-param predictor. Base = briefs 26_0422-042/26_0422-043 rfam100 unbucketed v5.5 ridge (validated for all clen on local lambda/mu and K; brief 26_0422-044). Override = brief 26_0422-045 synth large/huge bucket for glocal lambda + glocal K only, at clen>=threshold, where the base ridge extrapolates glocal lambda to non-physical negatives. Plus a positive glocal-lambda floor. Validated on 6 real large/huge NOSS (brief 26_0422-045 run dir: phase5_hybrid_report.txt). [R6L_R0G, brief 26_0823-004: local base cells refit; see provenance_R6L_R0G.]

selection_rule.note: Use largehuge_override[target][mode] when target in override_targets AND mode in override_modes AND clen>=override_clen_threshold; else use base[target][mode]. After predicting glocal lambda (ECMGC/ECMGI, any clen), clamp to >= glocal_lambda_floor. K models use y_transform=log (exponentiate prediction). base lambda/mu cells of form B_v42 carry a 'buckets' dict keyed tiny/small/medlarge; for clen>700 use the medlarge bucket. For clen>=clen_ge700_threshold use base_clen_ge700[target][mode] in place of base[target][mode] (the base cells were fit below clen 700 and are not used above it). The base cells with 'gc' in their schema use the corrected consensus-emission GC fraction. No clen<60 local lambda constant is applied to 0-bp models.

provenance.override: brief 26_0422-045 run dir: v55b_noss_bucketed_models.json (option b largehuge bucket)
